ranked.headline: Transfer-oriented integration of single-cell omics across cancer types and modalities
ranked.summary: Foundation-scale models and pan-cancer benchmarks now test whether single-cell integration transfers across cancer types and omic layers.

ranked.headline: Adapting RNA-seq quantification pipelines to bacterial, long-read and single-cell data
ranked.summary: Recent work extends transcript quantification and pre-processing tools to bacterial, long-read and single-cell transcriptomics data.

ranked.headline: Structure-conditioned models advance protein design, docking, and fitness prediction
ranked.summary: Structure-conditioned generators and few-shot predictors are now benchmarked against established baselines across design, docking, and fitness tasks.

ranked.headline: Scalable algorithms with formal guarantees for hashing, pooling, and library analysis
ranked.summary: Recent publications pair exact or collision-free algorithms with open implementations as chemical and genomic libraries grow.

ranked.headline: Integrative multi-omics and network evidence are narrowing regulatory gene candidates
ranked.summary: Multi-layer computational frameworks now combine eQTL, GWAS, and network evidence to prioritize regulatory genes in complex disease.

ranked.headline: New association methods model regulatory, missing and multitrait structure in GWAS
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications extend GWAS, fine-mapping and rare-variant models with functional annotation, missingness and multitrait information.

ranked.headline: Standardized frameworks unify quantitative analysis of spatial omics across platforms
ranked.summary: Spatial omics datasets now demand standardized QC and cross-platform alignment tools to ensure reproducible, integrated tissue-level analysis.

ranked.headline: Open tools now organize omics results, biomarker panels and gene-set interpretation
ranked.summary: Recent releases couple curated databases and machine learning with Bioconductor and web interfaces for omics results and biomarker selection.

ranked.headline: Assumption-light tools infer variants and repeat structure directly from sequencing reads
ranked.summary: Recent tools target computational scale, index reuse, and minimal model assumptions for variant and tandem repeat inference from short and long reads.

ranked.headline: Network models tested against empirical neural recordings and individual brain data
ranked.summary: Recent preprints confront whole-brain, mouse, and EEG data with network models, testing criticality, complexity, and consciousness-related dynamics directly.

ranked.headline: MD trajectories and all-atom models resolve binding mechanisms across target classes
ranked.summary: Preprints and publications pair MD analysis with benchmarked all-atom prediction, exposing limits in docking and antibody-antigen modeling.

ranked.headline: Benchmarking and deep learning models for TCR-pMHC and MHC-peptide binding prediction
ranked.summary: Unified benchmarks and new architectures test how evaluation design and input representation affect TCR-pMHC and MHC binding prediction accuracy.

ranked.headline: Compositional transforms and robust models recover protein-level information
ranked.summary: Recent MS proteomics methods address tumor cell-type deconvolution, differential expression, and protein abundance outlier detection.

ranked.headline: Open tools for phylogenetic, pangenome graph, and circadian data analysis
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a publication describe open, user-friendly tools for handling derived genomic and biological data representations.

ranked.headline: Software tools for metagenomics, metaproteomics, flux and genomic interval analysis
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications describe open computational tools built for throughput on large omics datasets and HPC systems.

ranked.headline: Software tools making structural and glycan data computable, comparable, and shareable
ranked.summary: Recent tools add archive-linked visualization, sub-millisecond glycan nomenclature canonicalization, and atomic interface analysis to structural workflows.

ranked.headline: Parallel and GPU-accelerated tools speed up sequencing and genomic data processing steps
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications target throughput bottlenecks in duplicate marking, single-cell quantification, and genomic coverage processing.

ranked.headline: Atom-level active-site geometry now guides de novo enzyme scaffold design
ranked.summary: Deep generative and hybrid ML-atomistic methods now scaffold catalytic geometry into de novo enzymes, with near-native activity reported.

ranked.headline: GANs and logic solvers generate synthetic biomedical data for training and privacy
ranked.summary: Synthetic data generators now serve as training resources and privacy-preserving substitutes for scarce or sensitive biomedical datasets.

ranked.headline: Graph-based methods resolve haplotypes from ambiguous, mixed, or low-coverage reads
ranked.summary: Recent graph-formulated haplotype methods add explicit uncertainty quantification and handle polyploid, mixed, and low-coverage samples.

ranked.headline: Physics-based models couple single-cell and spatial data across biological scales
ranked.summary: Recent work pairs mechanistic models with spatial transcriptomics and live imaging to make parameter-level links across scales explicit.

ranked.headline: Latent and manifold embeddings of multimodal brain data for biomarkers and forecasting
ranked.summary: Latent-space and manifold methods now link neuroimaging biomarkers to behavior and forecast cognitive decline from longitudinal multimodal data.

ranked.headline: Deep learning maps tumor omics to biomarkers, survival, and immunotherapy response
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications pair graph, foundation, and causal models with multi-omics data to yield interpretable cancer biomarkers and endpoints.

ranked.headline: Predicting mutations and drug response from lesion images, histology and genetics
ranked.summary: Recent preprints link lesion imaging, histology and genetic profiles to somatic mutation status and drug sensitivity predictions.

ranked.headline: Reliable inference for stochastic, deterministic and ODE models of biological dynamics
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a published workflow target identifiability, reliability and tractable inference across stochastic, PDE and ODE mechanistic models.

ranked.headline: Curated references and coverage-aware profilers refine microbiome metagenomic taxonomy
ranked.summary: Reference-anchored profiling tools and large gene catalogs now span fungal, viral, and environmental microbiome datasets.

ranked.headline: Segmental and whole-genome duplication shape regulatory elements and miRNA network structure
ranked.summary: Complete T2T genomes and interpretable genomic models now resolve duplication-linked regulatory elements from sequence and chromatin data to trait-level effects.

ranked.headline: Benchmarking variant and structural detection across sequencing platforms and assays
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and papers benchmark variant and inversion callers, extend truth sets, and harmonize large RNA-seq datasets, targeting accuracy at scale.

ranked.headline: Graph and language models infer biological associations across heterogeneous data
ranked.summary: Heterogeneous biomedical graphs, literature, and clinical records are being integrated for drug, adjuvant, and outcome prediction.

ranked.headline: Computational pipelines quantify single cells and nanoparticles from microscopy images
ranked.summary: Recent preprints pair deep learning and statistical detection with multi-channel, label-free, and nanoparticle imaging assays.

ranked.headline: Mutation-level fitness and within-host dynamics inferred from pathogen surveillance data
ranked.summary: Routine sequencing and wastewater streams now support mutation-level fitness and within-host viral dynamics inference at population scale.

ranked.headline: Generative and Bayesian samplers are checked against protein conformational landscapes
ranked.summary: Generative and Bayesian samplers are increasingly judged against physical observables such as conformational populations and folding pathways.

ranked.headline: Analytic models link detection and chromatin to apparent expression kinetics
ranked.summary: Imperfect single-cell detection and chromatin-gated bursting make observed kinetics depend on model structure rather than raw measurement.

ranked.headline: Environment-dependent energetics and dynamics reshape protein conformations and binding
ranked.summary: Recent MD and steered MD preprints link ligand, peptide and glycan environments to conformational energetics, pocket geometry and binding.

ranked.headline: Telomere-to-telomere assemblies expose Y-linked and odorant receptor duplications
ranked.summary: Complete and benchmarked reference assemblies now set the baseline for interpreting genomic features in apple and two dipteran species.

ranked.headline: Latent and mechanistic structure guiding multi-omic phenotype prediction
ranked.summary: Multi-omic phenotype prediction increasingly constrains models with explicit latent or predictability-based structure to aid interpretability.

ranked.headline: Explicit control of Turing patterns and perceptron thresholds in gene circuits
ranked.summary: Recent preprints treat pattern type, decision threshold, and resource-coupled weighting as explicit design variables for genetic circuits.

ranked.headline: Multiscale simulations couple valve mechanics, calcification, and atrial electromechanics
ranked.summary: Recent models quantify how fibrotic remodeling and calcification alter cardiac valve and atrial mechanical function.

ranked.headline: Plasmids drive T6SS dissemination as genomic taxonomy schemes sharpen lineage calls
ranked.summary: Mined plasmid and sequence databases now let genomic data resolve secretion-system spread and taxonomic species boundaries.

ranked.headline: Simplified microbial community models fail above coupling thresholds
ranked.summary: Explicit diagnostic criteria for when simplified community models fail are emerging alongside coexistence and robustness analyses.
